# Eternal CNC — Xinyongheng (Shenzhen) Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.

> Precision CNC machining factory in Shenzhen, China. Small-batch and prototype
> machining of aluminium, stainless steel, titanium and engineering plastics.
> 30 in-house CNC machines including 5-axis. Quote within 2 hours. MOQ 1 piece.

Eternal CNC (legal name: Xinyongheng (Shenzhen) Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.) is a
contract CNC machining manufacturer in Bao'an District, Shenzhen, China. It machines
aluminium, stainless steel, titanium and engineering plastics for engineers who need
small batches and prototypes, in aluminium 6061/7075, stainless 304/316, Ti-6Al-4V,
17-4PH, POM and PP. The factory holds 30 CNC machines including 5-axis milling,
3-axis and 4-axis vertical machining centres, CNC turning, wire EDM and precision
surface grinding. Typical milling tolerance is ±0.005 mm and turning ±0.01 mm.
Minimum order quantity is 1 piece. Standard quotes are returned within 2 hours.
Slogan: "Precision CNC Machining for Global Engineers".

## Company

- Legal name: Xinyongheng (Shenzhen) Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.
- Brand: Eternal CNC
- Location: Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Address: 101, Comprehensive Building, No. 33 Guangjin Road, Shapu Community, Songgang Street, Bao'an District
- Email: sales@eternalcnc.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 181 2398 3352
- Website: https://eternalcnc.com
- Slogan: Precision CNC Machining for Global Engineers

## Capabilities

- 5-axis simultaneous milling
- 3-axis and 4-axis vertical machining centres
- CNC turning (on our own group machines)
- Wire EDM
- Precision surface grinding
- DFM analysis and material selection support
- Surface finishing (performed by qualified subcontractors)
- CMM dimensional inspection (group-shared metrology centre)

## Materials

Aluminium AL-6061 / AL-7075, stainless steel SS304 / SS316, titanium Ti-6Al-4V,
17-4PH, POM, PP.

## Service parameters

- Milling tolerance: ±0.005 mm on critical features
- Turning tolerance: ±0.01 mm
- Turning capacity: max swing diameter 400 mm, max turning length 700 mm, bar feed up to 65 mm (our own group machines)
- Angular tolerance: ±0.01°; surface roughness Ra 0.4; GD&T per ISO 2768-f
- Quotation: within 2 hours (standard), 1 working day (complex), 2 working days (special)
- Prototype lead time: 3-5 days after drawing confirmation
- Minimum order quantity: 1 piece

## Equipment

12 machines have individual detail pages; the full in-house fleet numbers 30.

- CNC machining centres: CATO CT-80, Jiafu JF-500, Jiafu JF-600, Taikan T-V856S,
  Taikan T-500S, Taikan T-700SE, Taikan T-V1270S, WANGHUI XH-540, XINTENGHUI XTH-T540
- 5-axis: SUNRISE DMU-400 (gantry-type, direct-drive rotary table)
- CMM: Hexagon INSPECTOR CLASSIC
- Turned / wire-EDM / grinding equipment: see the equipment list page below

## Industries served

Automotive, medical devices, electronics, industrial robotics,
communications & satellite equipment, energy equipment, automation equipment.
